status: source only; no fresh model queries or return labels generated; separate preparation and root-reviewed freeze required
purpose: descriptive fresh-bank replication of within-state signed-Q-error alignment and candidate ranking for one frozen trained model; no p-values or winner threshold

frozen.width: actual native frozen_level_dose(reference,eta,.5).width with original floors/refusal and full produced precision; never rounded R*unit
frozen.deployment: authenticated v2 direct_policy: unchanged native float32 actor inference on one observation at a time; no JIT or precision change

states.law: fresh independent physical U[-.5,.5]^10; current.3/1.1; wave amplitude.2, uniform phase; designed reset-law state/time queries, not policy occupancy

candidates.construction: authenticated v2 builder: six distinct grid commands including projected actor and behavior mode if distinct, fill with uniform grid IDs without replacement; then original actor and five uniform[-1,1]^4 commands
candidates.duplicates: keep every index including actor/grid duplicate commands
candidates.behavior_mass: product .84 on mode coordinate and .04 on each other atom, zero off the exact float32 grid
candidates.support_classes: common beta>=.01; rare0<beta<.01; unsupported beta0; these are conditional action labels, not joint state support
candidates.width_permutation: one independent uniform permutation of12 indexed candidates at each state, precomputed stream6; permute usability with width

scores.constant_offset: Q1 minus mean usable U at that state, zero if none; must preserve raw ordering
scores.actor_control: original actor candidate index6 selected-return control only; no actor full-ranking score
scores.argmax: first exact maximum in fixed candidate index order, never chosen by oracle
scores.native_refusal: finite numerically unusable native width uses raw-score fallback; refusal alone does not remove the state or imply behavior-support failure

validity.state_invalid: any nonfinite numeric input, negative width, nonfinite score, nonfinite/missing true return, false finite/completed rollout flag or transition count other than100-time invalidates that whole state across paired arms; preserve all32 state indices and all384 candidate records, reasons and denominator, no replacement
validity.precedence: record native refusal and score fallback first; apply common invalid-state mask separately; nonfinite width still invalidates the state despite numeric raw-score fallback; physical-position threshold failure alone remains a measured valid outcome
validity.prelabel_invalid: skip its12 oracle continuations, retain missing-label status and count actual budget

truth.definition: candidate once then frozen unsmoothed actor via canonical single-row native policy toH100,gamma1, no terminalbootstrap or target-critic approximation
truth.plant: authenticated v2 training_eval._simulate, float64 plant and float32 observations/actions
truth.prior_validation: authenticate and reuse exact v2 passed608-transition receipt and unchanged source/model hashes; do not rerun fixtures
truth.label_uncertainty: deterministic numerical labels, not Monte Carlo Q estimates

primary_alignment.statistic: equal-state mean within-state centered Pearson(U,e) on its own defined states; distance and shuffled-U means likewise use their own defined states
primary_alignment.comparisons: paired statewise rho_U-rho_D and rho_U-rho_shuffled each use their own pair-specific common-defined intersection; save paired arm means on those same intersections and all denominators
primary_alignment.undefined: zero centered predictor or signed-error norm gives null, not zero correlation, with explicit per-predictor reasons; invalid numeric states reported separately
primary_alignment.pair_equivalence: centered Pearson equals normalized dot product over all i<j differences without re-centering those differences; all12 indices/duplicates retained; no near-tie exclusion here

primary_decision.statistic: equal-state mean concordance change versus rawQ, same true pairs for each arm
primary_decision.true_pairs: i<j with abs(Qpi_i-Qpi_j)>1e-6; true near-ties excluded
primary_decision.undefined: no comparable true pairs gives null; pairwise contrasts use same common-defined state intersection
primary_decision.denominators: record comparable pairs, true near-ties and predicted near-ties per state/arm

secondary: selected trueQpi and paired changes versus raw and original actor
direct paired selected-Qpi live-width minus matched-distance and live-width minus shuffled-width using shared state bootstrap
selected candidate index and actual command changes separately
actor command restoration when raw chose a different command; duplicate indices do not create artificial changes

bootstrap.unit: whole physical state, not actions or pairs
bootstrap.plan: one10000x32 plan sampled from all32 original states within context x time cells preserving3/3/2 counts, stream7, saved before labels and shared by every arm/endpoint
bootstrap.eligibility: apply endpoint common-defined masks to sampled indices, retain multiplicities, compute equal-state mean of defined contributions; never resample null states
bootstrap.interval: percentile[2.5,97.5]; any zero-defined or otherwise nonfinite replicate makes that endpoint interval unavailable; record every draw denominator and undefined count
bootstrap.no_extra_gate: no ad-hoc minimum-n filter, significance test or winner threshold
bootstrap.limitations: one trained checkpoint;32 designed states with2-3 per context-time cell; descriptive conditional uncertainty, not training-seed or population-Q evidence

execution.prepare: save raw states/actions, actual support masses, native outputs, fixed scores, width permutations, bootstrap indices, source/model/config hashes and metadata without Qpi labels
execution.run: requires root-reviewed freeze bound to source and all input hashes; exclusive new output directory, no ambiguous resume; no training
execution.tests: six fixed positive, negative, degenerate, ties/duplicates, constant-offset and invalid synthetic cases; zero model/simulator calls

limitations: This is a descriptive replication planned after the prior bank was inspected; it is not a confirmatory independent-training-seed experiment.
Native width calibrates historical one-step twin-min/noisy-target residuals at95k; it does not certify100k Q1 or long-return error.
Fresh designed state/time/action law differs from the pooled adaptive128-row calibration bank. Conditional categorical action support does not establish joint state coverage.
A candidate is followed by the original actor; these results do not evaluate a policy that repeatedly maximizes a corrected score.
One fixed width permutation is a placement control, not a permutation test. The inherited coefficient is fixed and no control is retuned.
No new training, checkpoint selection, kappa selection, Q coverage claim, uploads, or remote host access.
